fail_closed_policy: Any timeout, nonzero return code, missing output, non-unique parse, msolve variable-order disagreement, or msolve/Singular disagreement yields UNKNOWN.
The target launches only after both controls agree with their exact expected verdicts.

Row-group minimization launches only after full-target UNIT consensus, uses fresh Singular processes under one 240-second total budget, and independently replays a claimed core in both msolve orders and Singular.
The permanent RUN_ONCE.guard is created before generated inputs or solver calls; no generated artifact may be overwritten.
claim_boundary: A verdict concerns only this fixed finite 13-row gauge equality packet. It is not a P97 counterexample, universal theorem, finite-to-universal lift, Lean theorem, or proof-spine closure.
post_wave_mine: At terminal, inspect only this probe's controls, target records, and any minimized row-core records. Do not search prior waves or theorem banks.
